fornitori.descrizione: Nestled in the heart of the Chianti Classico countryside, just 40 minutes from Florence and Siena, Borgo Vescine is a beautifully preserved medieval hamlet offering an authentic Tuscan experience surrounded by vineyards, olive groves, and rolling hills. The property combines timeless charm, elegant hospitality, and breathtaking scenery, making it an exceptional setting for destination weddings and exclusive celebrations. The borgo features 28 charming rooms accommodating up to 65 guests, allowing family and friends to stay together in a unique and intimate atmosphere. Historic stone pathways, panoramic views, and picturesque squares create a magical backdrop for every moment of the celebration. Wedding events can seamlessly unfold across the property's various venues. The Olive Grove (Uliveta), framed by centuries-old olive trees and a charming gazebo, provides a romantic setting for symbolic ceremonies. The Panoramic Terrace and Italian Gardens are perfect for elegant aperitifs and cocktail receptions, while the iconic Piazza del Borgo offers a spectacular location for al fresco dinners under the stars. Guests can also enjoy memorable experiences such as wine tastings in the historic Wine Room, vineyard walks accompanied by the resident sommelier, cocktails at the Borgo Bar or Pool Bar, and refined dining at La Terrazza del Borgo restaurant. After dinner, celebrations continue in the elegant Orangerie, where DJ sets, dancing, and open bar service create the perfect atmosphere for an unforgettable party. Music is permitted until 11:30 PM for non-exclusive events and until 2:00 AM with an exclusive buyout of the property. Extensions beyond 2:00 AM are available for an additional fee. With its authentic Tuscan character, exclusive-use possibilities, and stunning Chianti setting, Borgo Vescine is an ideal choice for couples seeking a romantic and truly memorable destination wedding experience.

Byblos Art Hotel Villa Amistà is a distinctive luxury property set in a historic Venetian villa just outside Verona, surrounded by landscaped gardens and peaceful countryside. The hotel is renowned for its striking blend of classical architecture and contemporary art, where frescoed ceilings and elegant period details are contrasted with bold modern design pieces throughout the interiors. Rooms and suites are individually styled, combining artistic expression with refined comfort and modern amenities.

More than a historic estate, Castello Dal Pozzo is a place to experience. Set within 60 acres of centuries-old parkland overlooking the shimmering waters of Lake Maggiore, this enchanting Neo-Gothic castle has been owned by the same noble family for generations. Today, it welcomes guests as an elegant 5-star resort, where timeless heritage, refined interiors, and modern comforts blend seamlessly. Surrounded by pristine gardens and breathtaking lake views, the estate retains its authentic character and sense of place. Every detail tells a story, every space reflects its rich history, and every stay feels uniquely personal.

servizi.titolo: Private evening tour of Rome by Golfcart
servizi.descrizione: Late in the afternoon, meet your private driver escort and set off on a charming golf cart tour through the illuminated streets of Rome. As twilight falls, discover the Eternal City from a unique perspective, when its iconic monuments and piazzas are beautifully lit and the atmosphere becomes truly magical. Your tour will take you to some of Rome's most celebrated landmarks, including Piazza del Popolo, the elegant Spanish Steps, and the world-famous Trevi Fountain, where you may wish to toss a coin and make a wish. Continue through the lively Piazza Navona and Piazza della Rotonda, home to the magnificent Pantheon, where ancient history and vibrant city life blend seamlessly. Proceed to Piazza Venezia, dominated by the impressive Vittoriano Monument, also known as the Altar of the Fatherland, which houses the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Throughout the tour, there will be opportunities to stop, stroll, and take memorable photographs. To conclude the experience, reach Gianicolo Hill, one of Rome's most scenic viewpoints, offering breathtaking panoramic views over the city's rooftops, domes, and monuments. After enjoying this unforgettable panorama, return comfortably to your hotel.

Learn about the fascinating history of the Roman Empire, the gladiatorial games, and the spectacles that once captivated thousands of spectators. Continue to the Roman Forum, the heart of political, religious, and commercial life in Ancient Rome. As you stroll among the impressive ruins, your guide will bring centuries of history to life with engaging stories and insights into daily life during the Empire. Following your exploration of Ancient Rome, enjoy a walking tour through the historic center, discovering elegant piazzas, picturesque streets, and architectural treasures that reflect the city's unique blend of past and present. Throughout the day, your guide will introduce you to Rome's rich cultural heritage, offering a perfect balance of historical discovery and authentic local atmosphere.

servizi.descrizione: Discover Milan, Italy’s vibrant capital of fashion, design, and culture, on this privately guided half-day tour. A city where centuries of history blend seamlessly with contemporary elegance, Milan offers a fascinating mix of Gothic masterpieces, artistic treasures, world-famous landmarks, and stylish boulevards. Begin with a visit to the magnificent Duomo di Milano, the city’s iconic cathedral and one of the largest Gothic churches in the world. Inside, admire its soaring columns, stunning stained-glass windows, intricate sculptures, and centuries of history that make this sacred monument truly unforgettable. Continue through the heart of the city, strolling beneath the elegant glass-vaulted roof of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, one of Europe's oldest and most beautiful shopping arcades. Nearby, admire the world-renowned La Scala Theatre, one of the most prestigious opera houses in the world. A highlight of the tour is the visit to Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper, one of the most celebrated masterpieces of the Renaissance and a true bucket-list experience for art lovers. The tour also offers an introduction to Milan’s celebrated fashion scene, with a walk through the elegant streets of the renowned Quadrilatero della Moda, home to prestigious boutiques, designer ateliers, and international luxury brands.

servizi.titolo: Half day Venice walking tour
servizi.descrizione: Step into the timeless beauty of Venice, a city that for centuries stood at the heart of one of the most powerful maritime republics in the Mediterranean. Shaped by its influential Doges and centuries of trade with the East, Venice remains a fascinating blend of history, culture, and architectural splendor. Your guided walking tour begins in the magnificent St. Mark’s Square, often described as the drawing room of Europe and the only square in Venice known as a piazza. Here, admire the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the elegant Procuratie, the stunning St. Mark’s Basilica, the historic Clock Tower, and the symbols that celebrate Venice’s glorious past. Continue with a view of the famous Bridge of Sighs, one of the city's most photographed monuments, before venturing into the heart of authentic Venice. Follow your guide through a maze of charming alleyways and picturesque campi (squares), where everyday Venetian life unfolds amidst beautiful palaces, historic churches, and lively local corners. The tour concludes at the iconic Rialto Bridge, one of Venice’s most celebrated landmarks and the historic commercial heart of the city. Here, your guide will be happy to provide recommendations for further independent exploration, shopping, or leisure time along the enchanting canals.

servizi.titolo: Afternoon Venice Gondola Experience
servizi.descrizione: No visit to Venice is complete without experiencing its most iconic and timeless tradition: a gondola ride through the city’s enchanting canals. Glide gracefully along the waterways aboard the elegant black gondola, a symbol of Venice for centuries. Skillfully steered by expert gondoliers using a single oar, these traditional boats offer a unique perspective of the city, revealing hidden corners, charming bridges, historic palaces, and picturesque canal-side scenes inaccessible by foot. As you navigate both the quieter canals and sections of the Grand Canal, you will gain a deeper appreciation of the special relationship between Venice and its lagoon— a bond that has shaped the city’s history, culture, and daily life for generations. This unforgettable experience offers a relaxing and authentic way to immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of one of the world's most extraordinary destinations.

servizi.titolo: Private half day excursion to the islands of Murano and Burano with glass blowing demonstration
servizi.descrizione: Escape the crowds of Venice and immerse yourself in the timeless beauty of the Venetian Lagoon with a memorable excursion to the enchanting islands of Murano and Burano, each renowned for its unique heritage and traditions. Your journey begins in Murano, world- famous for its centuries-old glassmaking tradition. Since 1291, the island has been home to master artisans who transformed glass production into an art form recognized around the globe. During a visit to a historic glass factory, witness a fascinating live demonstration and admire the extraordinary skill with which molten glass is shaped into elegant and intricate works of art. Continue by boat to the colorful island of Burano, celebrated for its picturesque canals, vibrant fishermen’s houses, and long-standing lace-making tradition. Dating back to the 15th century, Burano lace became a symbol of prestige and refinement, and the island remains an important guardian of this delicate craftsmanship. servizi.titolo: Private transfer from hotel in Venice to hotel in Florence with stop for Parmigiano cheese factory in Parma and ham producer in Modena
servizi.descrizione: Travel comfortably from Venice to Florence while discovering two of the culinary treasures that have made the Emilia- Romagna region famous throughout the world. After departing Venice, journey into the heart of Italy’s celebrated Food Valley for an authentic introduction to some of the country's most iconic gastronomic traditions. Your first stop is a renowned Parmigiano Reggiano dairy, where you will learn about the centuries-old production process behind the “King of Cheeses.” Explore the facilities, discover the craftsmanship involved in its creation, and gain insight into the strict standards that make Parmigiano Reggiano one of Italy’s most treasured products. Continue to the Modena area for a visit to a traditional ham producer, where local experts will introduce you to the techniques and traditions behind the region’s celebrated cured meats. This fascinating experience offers a unique glimpse into Italy’s rich food culture and the dedication of artisans who preserve these time-honored methods. Following your visits, relax as you continue south through the picturesque Italian countryside toward Florence, the cradle of the Renaissance, where you will be transferred directly to your hotel.

servizi.titolo: Private half day walking tour of Florence
servizi.descrizione: Discover the timeless beauty of Florence, the cradle of the Renaissance and one of Italy’s most captivating cities. With its compact historic center, elegant architecture, and wealth of artistic treasures, Florence is best explored on foot. Accompanied by your expert guide, enjoy a leisurely walk through the city's most celebrated landmarks and hidden corners. Admire the magnificent Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, with its iconic dome dominating the skyline, and the elegant Giotto’s Bell Tower. Stroll through the historic Piazza della Signoria, the political heart of Florence for centuries, and continue to Piazza Santa Croce, home to one of the city's most important churches. Your walk also includes the famous Ponte Vecchio, Florence’s oldest bridge and one of its most recognizable symbols, lined with traditional artisan shops. Beyond the iconic sights, discover lesser-known gems such as the remarkable Orsanmichele, a masterpiece of Florentine Gothic architecture, and the beloved Porcellino Fountain, whose bronze boar is said to bring good luck to those who rub its nose. Throughout the tour, your guide will bring Florence's rich history to life through fascinating stories, intriguing anecdotes, and insights into the influential families, artists, and visionaries who shaped this extraordinary city.

servizi.titolo: Private transfer from hotel in Florence to hotel in Pisa with stop in Volterra and Pisa tour
servizi.descrizione: After breakfast and check-out, meet your assistant and private drivers and transfer by minivan to Florence Cascine Coach Terminal. Here, board your private coach and depart for Pisa, enjoying a stop along the way in the enchanting hilltop town of Volterra. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and discover one of Tuscany’s most captivating medieval towns. Rich in Etruscan heritage and surrounded by sweeping countryside views, Volterra offers a fascinating blend of history, culture, and authentic Tuscan charm. Stroll through its atmospheric streets and picturesque squares while learning about the town’s remarkable past and its important role throughout the centuries. Following your visit, continue to Pisa. Once one of the most powerful Maritime Republics of the Mediterranean, Pisa is home to the world-famous Piazza dei Miracoli, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Italy’s most extraordinary architectural complexes. During your guided visit, admire the magnificent Cathedral, the striking Baptistery, the iconic Leaning Tower, and the Monumental Cemetery (Camposanto), all exceptional examples of Pisan Romanesque architecture. As your guide unveils the rich history behind these monuments, discover the artistic and cultural influences that shaped Pisa during its golden age. Your visit includes access to the Cathedral and Baptistery, offering a deeper insight into the city’s heritage and architectural splendor. For those wishing to experience one of Italy’s most famous landmarks from within, an ascent of the Leaning Tower is also included. After the tour, transfer to your hotel in Pisa for check-in and overnight. servizi.titolo: Afternoon Private Roman Forum and Colosseum half day tour
servizi.descrizione: Step back in time and discover the heart of Ancient Rome on a guided journey through two of the city's most iconic archaeological sites. Begin with a visit to the legendary Colosseum, the largest amphitheater ever built and one of the most recognizable monuments in the world. A masterpiece of Roman engineering, the Colosseum once hosted spectacular gladiatorial contests, public spectacles, and grand events attended by thousands of spectators. More than just entertainment, these games played an important role in Roman society, serving as a powerful tool for emperors to reinforce their authority and maintain public support. Continue to the nearby Roman Forum, the political, religious, and commercial center of ancient Rome for centuries. This remarkable archaeological area was once the stage upon which the history of the Roman Empire unfolded. As you stroll among the remains of temples, basilicas, triumphal arches, and government buildings, your expert guide will bring the ancient city back to life, revealing stories of emperors, politicians, merchants, and ordinary citizens who shaped the destiny of Rome. Through engaging commentary and fascinating historical insights, gain a deeper understanding of the daily life, achievements, and legacy of one of the greatest civilizations in history. servizi.titolo: Private Vatican Museums half day tour
servizi.descrizione: Prepare for an extraordinary journey through art, history, and faith as you explore one of the world's most celebrated cultural treasures: the Vatican Museums. Home to centuries of papal patronage, the Vatican Museums house an unparalleled collection of masterpieces gathered by the Popes throughout the ages. As you walk through magnificent galleries, richly decorated halls, and elegant courtyards, your expert guide will unveil the stories behind some of the greatest works of Renaissance and classical art. Discover masterpieces created by legendary artists such as Raphael, Botticelli, Pinturicchio, and Michelangelo, whose creativity helped shape the artistic heritage of Western civilization. The highlight of the visit is undoubtedly the Sistine Chapel, where Michelangelo's breathtaking ceiling frescoes and monumental Last Judgment continue to inspire and captivate visitors from around the globe. This immersive experience offers a unique opportunity to admire some of humanity’s greatest artistic achievements while gaining insight into the spiritual and historical significance of Vatican City. servizi.titolo: Private full day tour to Pompeii
servizi.descrizione: Travel south through the Italian countryside towards Pompeii, one of the most extraordinary archaeological sites in the world. Along the way, admire views of Mount Vesuvius, the imposing volcano whose catastrophic eruption in AD 79 both destroyed and remarkably preserved this thriving Roman city for centuries. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and begin an immersive exploration of the ancient ruins. Walk along remarkably preserved streets and discover a city frozen in time, where homes, temples, baths, shops, and public buildings offer a fascinating glimpse into daily life during the Roman Empire. As you stroll through the archaeological site, your expert guide will bring Pompeii’s history to life, revealing the stories of its inhabitants and the dramatic events that led to the city's sudden demise. From intricate frescoes and ancient marketplaces to grand villas and public squares, each corner of Pompeii tells the story of a sophisticated civilization preserved beneath volcanic ash for nearly two millennia. During the day, your dedicated tour escort will be happy to recommend suitable local venues for lunch or a light snack at your leisure. servizi.titolo: The Oltrarno neighborhood: Pitti Palace and Boboli Gardens private half day walking tour
servizi.descrizione: Meet your private guide at 3:30 PM outside Caffè Rivoire, the historic café located in Piazza della Signoria, at the corner of Via Vacchereccia, and begin your exploration of Florence’s elegant Oltrarno district. Located on the opposite side of the Arno River, Oltrarno is one of Florence’s most authentic neighborhoods, where artisans, local traditions, and remarkable historic landmarks still preserve the city's timeless charm. It was here that many noble families chose to settle during the Renaissance, seeking a quieter and healthier environment away from the crowded city center. Your visit begins at the magnificent Pitti Palace, the grand residence that became the symbol of Medici power and one of the most important palaces in Florence. Originally adopted by the Medici family in the 16th century as their preferred residence, the palace houses an extraordinary collection of paintings and artworks gathered not simply to display wealth and power, but to decorate the family's private living spaces with pieces they genuinely admired. After exploring the palace interiors, continue to the stunning Boboli Gardens, one of the finest examples of an Italian Renaissance garden. With elegant pathways, sculptures, fountains, and panoramic views, the gardens became a model for royal and noble gardens throughout Europe. Here, art, nature, symmetry, and the display of prestige combine to create an extraordinary open- air museum. As you wander through the palace and gardens, you will discover the fascinating story of the Medici dynasty, admire remarkable works of art, and enjoy one of Florence's most beautiful and iconic landscapes. Departure Time: 3:30 PM Meeting Point: Outside Caffè Rivoire, Piazza della Signoria (corner of Via Vacchereccia)

servizi.titolo: Private Florence Walk and Taste half day tour
servizi.descrizione: Discover Florence through its flavors on this delightful walking tour that showcases the city's rich culinary traditions and local specialties. A perfect introduction to Florentine culture, this experience offers a unique perspective on a city where beauty, art, history, and gastronomy have been intertwined since the Renaissance. Accompanied by your private guide, begin your journey with a traditional Italian coffee and fresh pastry before exploring the vibrant Mercato Centrale, Florence's historic covered market. Wander through the bustling stalls filled with local produce, meats, cheeses, and regional delicacies while learning about the ingredients that define Tuscan cuisine. As you stroll through the city's charming streets and hidden corners, enjoy a variety of carefully selected tastings, including a traditional schiacciata with truffle, a selection of fried fish and vegetables, and refreshing seasonal treats. Continue into the authentic Oltrarno district, where local life still thrives, and conclude with a generous charcuterie and cheese board paired with a glass of Chianti wine, produced in the rolling hills surrounding Florence.

Private Milan Walking Tour
servizi.descrizione: Milan is the perfect blend of romance and urban sophistication. Unlike many Italian cities, it is not defined by a single architectural style or historical era, but rather showcases influences spanning from Gothic masterpieces to Futurist innovation. It is an ideal destination for those wishing to experience Italy's contemporary elegance and vibrant cultural scene. Begin at the iconic Duomo, admiring the breathtaking façade of this magnificent cathedral, whose construction spanned over six centuries. From its highest point, tradition says that the golden statue of the Madonnina watches over the city. Accompanied by your private guide, enjoy a leisurely walk through Milan's historic center, discovering highlights such as the elegant Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the world-renowned La Scala Opera House, and the impressive Sforza Castle, a 14th- century fortress housing remarkable museums and art collections. Milan is also internationally celebrated as Italy's fashion capital. Follow your guide through the prestigious Fashion District, strolling along Via Montenapoleone and Via della Spiga, where luxury boutiques and designer ateliers stand as symbols of timeless style and creativity. The tour concludes back at Piazza Duomo.

Borgo Vescine
servizi.descrizione: Nestled in the heart of the Chianti Classico countryside, just 40 minutes from Florence and Siena, Borgo Vescine is a beautifully preserved medieval hamlet offering an authentic Tuscan experience surrounded by vineyards, olive groves, and rolling hills. The property combines timeless charm, elegant hospitality, and breathtaking scenery, making it an exceptional setting for destination weddings and exclusive celebrations. The borgo features 28 charming rooms accommodating up to 65 guests, allowing family and friends to stay together in a unique and intimate atmosphere. Historic stone pathways, panoramic views, and picturesque squares create a magical backdrop for every moment of the celebration. Wedding events can seamlessly unfold across the property's various venues. The Olive Grove (Uliveta), framed by centuries-old olive trees and a charming gazebo, provides a romantic setting for symbolic ceremonies. The Panoramic Terrace and Italian Gardens are perfect for elegant aperitifs and cocktail receptions, while the iconic Piazza del Borgo offers a spectacular location for al fresco dinners under the stars. Guests can also enjoy memorable experiences such as wine tastings in the historic Wine Room, vineyard walks accompanied by the resident sommelier, cocktails at the Borgo Bar or Pool Bar, and refined dining at La Terrazza del Borgo restaurant. After dinner, celebrations continue in the elegant Orangerie, where DJ sets, dancing, and open bar service create the perfect atmosphere for an unforgettable party. Music is permitted until 11:30 PM for non-exclusive events and until 2:00 AM with an exclusive buyout of the property. Extensions beyond 2:00 AM are available for an additional fee. With its authentic Tuscan character, exclusive-use possibilities, and stunning Chianti setting, Borgo Vescine is an ideal choice for couples seeking a romantic and truly memorable destination wedding experience.
